augment_gpt2_config: augment a GPT2Config to add cross-attention and tanh gating parameters for encoder-decoder use
load_tf_weights_in_gpt2: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into a PyTorch GPT-2 model from a given path
GPT2LMHeadModel_freeze_lm_weights: freeze pretrained GPT-2 LM weights and keep only cross-attention and gating parameters trainable
GPT2Model_forward: run the bare GPT-2 transformer forward pass with optional encoder hidden states for cross-attention
GPT2ForSequenceClassification_forward: run GPT-2 forward pass with a sequence classification head for single or multi-label tasks
